title: Tech Note: ORDA and Forms
author: Timothy Aaron Penner, Senior Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: List box with Entity Selection data source
DIALOG command for sheet-form CRUD dialogs

historical_commentary.text: This is a foundational, still fully accurate ORDA CRUD tutorial: .new()/.save()/.query()/.all()/.drop() and binding a list box directly to an entity selection via Form.selection remain the standard, current way to build ORDA-driven forms in 4D, unchanged since this note's publication.
related_updates: ORDA entity/entity-selection CRUD (.new(), .save(), .query(), .all(), .drop()) remains 4D's current, unchanged data-access API
Binding list boxes directly to an Entity Selection with This.FieldName column expressions is still the standard modern 4D form pattern
